items.exampleEn: I want a cup of tea.
Can you tell me the way to the station?
items.exampleZh: 你可以告訴我去車站的路嗎？

items.exampleEn: This cake is good. Try it!
items.exampleZh: 這個蛋糕很好吃，試試看！

items.sentenceEn: Please give me a call tonight.

items.audioEn: Look! I can't find my phone. Can you call it for me?
items.audioZh: 你看！我找不到我的手機，你可以幫我打打看嗎？

items.sentenceEn: I want to ask my teacher a question.

items.stemZh: 請再告訴我一次你的名字。

items.stemEn: I can't ____ my glasses. Where are they?
items.stemZh: 我找不到我的眼鏡，它們在哪裡？

items.passageEn: Jenny wants to make a cake, but she can't find the sugar. She calls her mother and asks, "Where is the sugar?" Her mother tells her to look in the box on the shelf. Jenny finds it. Her first try is not very good, but her second cake is great!
items.passageZh: Jenny 想做蛋糕，可是找不到糖。她打電話問媽媽：「糖在哪裡？」媽媽要她去看架子上的盒子。Jenny 找到了。她第一次做得不太好，但第二個蛋糕很棒！

questions.questionZh: Jenny 打電話問媽媽什麼？

referenceEn: I want to ask you a question.
I would like to ask you a question.
rubricZh: 「想要做⋯」可用 want to、would like to 等＋原形
ask 後面可直接接人和問題（例如 ask you a question）
look 後面接形容詞表示「看起來」（例如 look happy）
「很開心」可寫，例如 very happy、so happy 等
